seo.title: About Helix24 Solutions | Digital Agency in Kochi, Kerala
seo.description: Helix24 Solutions Pvt Ltd is a registered digital marketing and web development company in Kochi, serving businesses across Kerala and the GCC.

hero.title: Marketing and websites,
hero.intro: Helix24 Solutions Pvt Ltd is a digital marketing and web development company in Kochi, Kerala. We help businesses across Kerala and the GCC get found online, build websites that work well on a phone, and get more calls and WhatsApp messages from customers.

story.title: What we do
paragraphs: Most businesses we meet have been told to choose between a marketing agency and a web developer. In practice the two depend on each other: ads send people to a website, and the website decides whether they enquire. So we do both, with one team responsible for the result.

Our services cover [social media marketing](/social-media-marketing), [Google Ads and SEO](/digital-marketing-seo), [websites](/web-development), [online stores](/ecommerce-development), [mobile apps](/mobile-app-development) and [branding](/branding-design).

items.title: Measured by enquiries and sales
items.text: We set up tracking before we spend your budget, and report on leads, cost per lead and sales rather than likes and impressions.

items.title: Everything stays in your name
items.text: Ad accounts, Meta Pixel, analytics, website code and domains are created in your name. If you ever move on, you keep all of it.

items.title: Direct communication
items.text: You talk to the people doing the work, on WhatsApp, phone or video call, without messages passing through layers of account managers.

items.title: A registered company
items.text: Helix24 Solutions Pvt Ltd is registered with the Registrar of Companies, Kerala. We work with written proposals, GST invoices and NDAs on request.

areas.title: From Kochi, working across Kerala and the GCC
areas.intro: We work with clients in these regions on WhatsApp, phone and video calls.
